title: Beyond Detection: Unveiling Fairness Vulnerabilities in Abusive Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The single mention of 'religious beliefs' is a hypothetical example in the introduction of how an attack could be used, but it is not implemented or tested in the research.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its experiments focus on fairness related to race and gender in abusive language detection.
